decision.explanation: The question asks for the population of Moose Lake Township, Minnesota. Multiple sources provide conflicting values depending on the year and possibly different townships within Minnesota. Document D1S2 and D1S4 state the population was 205 as of the 2000 census. Document D4S1 states 956 as of the 2000 census. Document D6S6 states 142 as of the 2000 census. Document D2S5 states 3.3k people in Moose Lake, MN. Document D3S5 states approximately 5,000 residents. These values are preserved as they represent distinct referents or timeframes.
